name: scoop-manifest
body: Scoop manifest: the bucket's `kalide` manifest (`bucket/kalide.json`, bucket `kalide`) plus a token-aware workaround (Scoop has no native auth-header support; e.g. a pre-install script using the user's `KALIDE_GITHUB_TOKEN`) to fetch the `kalide-windows-<arch>` asset from the private GitHub Release of really-knows-ai/kalide. Exact mechanism is an implementation decision.
